name: palette-strip
title: Palette Strip
description: Colour swatches joined into one bar that wipe to new colours in turn, with a spinning shuffle button.

perf.budget: Each swatch wipe is one UI-thread transform for about half a second after the colours change; at rest nothing animates.

a11y.reducedMotion: Swatches change colour in place and the shuffle icon does not spin.
a11y.screenReader: Without onSwatchPress the bar is one image named after its colours; with it, each swatch is a button named after its colour.
a11y.touchTarget: Swatches are 44 pt tall; the action button is 44 pt.
